content: MK's note: Nūrī owned the earliest and most comprehensive collection of Ibn Turka's works, now MS Majlis 10196, and left marginal comments throughout, extensively on the K. al-Mafaḥiṣ and on R. Nuqṭa, R. Ḥurūf and R. Suʾl al-Mulūk.
refers_to_primary: MS Majlis 10196, marginalia of Mullā ʿAlī Nūrī
